mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 55 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Area High School, and under a full moon, we expect an overnight low of 47 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

Construction updates show that a portion of Hwy M will be closed from October 5 to October 7 for final pavement work, requiring drivers to follow detour signs. Additionally, the city has issued a scam alert reminding residents that they do not accept planning or zoning fees via wire transfer or online credit card payments.
There is plenty to do today, including the Dane County Farmer's Market and live music at several local venues, plus yoga coming up on September 28 and trivia nights starting September 29.

On September 5, Verona police officers investigated a report of multiple vehicles featuring slices of cheese on their windshields, identifying it as a viral social media trend known as the Dairy Dare.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. Culver's is currently open but will be closing in 23 minutes, so make sure to get there soon.
